system.installTime: Body x 160 hrs/Vehicle B/R(10-On-Road Handling), Computer(4), Electronics(4)
system.description: Computer-controlled steering. Handling −1 a level (levels 1-3), and a one-time +10% the player splits among Acceleration, Speed and Load, taken after every other change (set it on this mod). Not with improved suspension or control surfaces. Parts: the vehicle's original cost × 0.25 a level (worked out when installed). R3R p.129.
